notes:
Fish ESP, plus a fix for this dialog.

- Fish ESP: boxes, names, distance, tracers and edge arrows for every roaming fish, with the rarity on the plate (Sea Bass - Common).
- Relic ESP card with its own switch and tier filter.
- Visuals tab on the rail.
- Cast and Reel & shake got master switches; the card dims when the group is off.
- ESP calibration moved to Settings.
- The overlay is click-through again, so the camera works while it draws.
- Long changelogs now scroll inside the update dialog instead of pushing Install off screen.
